trace.final:
Both actions are complete. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Summary

**Investigation:**
- `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was **unhealthy** with an error rate of 0.18.
- Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all production regions — rollback reported `rolled_out` status.
2. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0002, status: open, on-call paged) titled "checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy", documenting the failure and the rollback. (The first attempt timed out, so I retried and it succeeded.)

**Verification:**
- Post-rollback status confirms checkout-api is now on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy**, with error rate dropped to 0.002.

Note: The rollback to v2.3.0 was a previously healthy production version, so no change-manager approval was required.
